description: Upsert spending policy rules for an AI commerce agent, including maximum per-transaction USD amount, daily budget cap, auto-approve threshold, and allowed blockchain networks/tokens.

agent_id.description: Public ID of the target AI agent.

allowed_networks.description: List of permitted blockchain network keys.

auto_approve_under.description: Transactions below this USD amount are auto-approved; higher amounts enter the human approval queue.

daily_limit_amount.description: Maximum daily cumulative spend in USD.

max_tx_amount.description: Maximum allowed single transaction amount in USD.

name: xpayr_update_ai_agent_policy
